The store filter is FOX - פוקס and the four result cards are the four real FOX deals: Hever (חבר) — Gift Cards at 30% capped ₪300, PaisPlus — Networks Cash Card at 25%, HOT Israel's תו קניה FOX (רק ₪154.00) and Isracard TopCash's 3% cashback. Four cards make the list 1,216px tall, so the second stop keeps the screen full instead of leaving white above the nav. The pointer withdraws to a bottom-left rest at 3.66s rather than hovering over content that has slid out from under it.
